sensor_asymmetry_note: SENSOR ASYMMETRY: P&O and IncCond use only PV voltage/current (no irradiance or temperature sensor, as in low-cost MPPT hardware); Poly2(G,T)-MPPT and ANN-MPPT also use G and T sensors; the scan-based controllers (Scan+P&O, DNN scan-only, Hybrid) additionally need a fast I-V scan capability. The fair, equal-information comparison for the ANN is therefore Poly2(G,T)-MPPT, not P&O/IncCond. Sensor-equipped P&O variants (e.g. model-based start-up or step-size scheduling) were NOT implemented.

dnn_spec.training_target: V_mpp(G,T): voltage of the true MPP of the single-diode PV model (Cell 2) at the sample's (G,T)
dnn_spec.loss: mean squared error on standardised V_mpp
dnn_spec.conversion_to_command: V_next = V + clip(V_ref - V, -slew, +slew); duty = 1 - V_next / V_bus (ideal boost, plotted only)
dnn_spec.oracle_use: the true MPP is used ONLY to create labels and to score results; never inside a controller
dnn_spec.honest_limit: labels come from the same physics model that generates the closed-loop plant, so in-distribution scores are optimistic; range-split tests (hot / high-irradiance / later years) and a mismatched-plant test are therefore reported separately

metric_definitions.tracking_efficiency_%: eta_track = 100 * sum_k P(k) / sum_k P_mpp(k)  (energy-weighted; P = delivered power at the applied voltage, P_mpp = true maximum power of THE ACTUAL PLANT at the same conditions)
metric_definitions.convergence_steps: after an event e (run start, irradiance step, new shading pattern): first control cycle s >= e such that P/P_mpp >= 0.98 for 10 consecutive cycles; convergence = s - e cycles (1 cycle = 1 s). Mean over events that converge before the next event; 'n_not_converged' counts the others
metric_definitions.osc_amp_V: mean peak-to-peak operating-voltage excursion in non-overlapping 10-cycle windows that are quasi-steady (true V_mpp moves <= 0.25 V), contain no scan cycle, and start >= 50 cycles after the last event
metric_definitions.scan_overhead_%: scan controllers only: 100 * sum(P_mpp - P) over scan cycles / sum(P_mpp) (energy given up during the I-V scans; included in tracking efficiency)
metric_definitions.osc_amp_P_%: same windows: peak-to-peak of P/P_mpp, in %
metric_definitions.shading_success_%: partial-shading only: % of the 9 episodes in which mean(P) over the last 25% of the episode >= 95% of the global-MPP power
metric_definitions.compute_us_per_cycle: mean wall-clock time of the controller decision only (P&O/IncCond rules; or polynomial / scaler + DNN forward call); plant model and logging excluded
